desc:
🔥 Free Fire Zone Max 🔥
The most intense battle royale on Roblox! Jump from the plane, choose where to land, get your gear, and fight until you are the last one standing. Go for the BOOYAH!

🎯 GAME MODES
• Battle Royale: survive the zone and eliminate all your rivals
• 4v4 Tournament (DE): show your squad's power
• Seasonal ranks: climb from Bronze to Grandmaster

⚔️ FEATURES
• Large arsenal: rifles, submachine guns, shotguns, sniper rifles, and more
• Gloo Walls to instantly cover yourself during combat
• Characters with unique abilities
• Pets, emotes, and skins to customize your style
• Lucky Royale, VIP Pass, and special events
• Global leaderboards for kills and rank

💾 Were you playing before? Your progress is automatically restored: rank, kills, weapons, diamonds, skins, and more.

📱 Available on PC and mobile.
👍 Like it and add it to your favorites so you don't miss any updates!
